summary: Key gaps: Loro migration (automerge → loro 1.13.x, G-11), IrohDocsAdapter implementation (G-10), sync-service binary (G-02), MCP server via rmcp 1.8.0 (G-03). Operator additions assessed: Signal Protocol REJECTED (iroh QUIC TLS 1.3 is sufficient), Temporal.io REJECTED for P2P node (requires server cluster; deferred to cloud substrate), Go/Loro FFI REJECTED (no Go bindings exist for iroh or Loro; use HTTP REST client). Phase split recommended: Phase A (18 changes, core infra + skills + Rust SDK) vs Phase B (Tauri plugin, WASM, TS SDK, Go SDK, Docusaurus). Open questions OQ-1 (split) and OQ-4 (delete AutomergeEngine?) require operator decision before /kbd-plan proceeds.
open_questions: OQ-1: Accept Phase A/B split or collapse to single phase?
OQ-4: Delete AutomergeEngine outright or keep as feature flag?
locked_decisions: Go SDK via HTTP REST (no FFI)
